title: Fix Use Sync External Store Shim In Desktop Vite
description: Resolve CJS/ESM use-sync-external-store/shim under Vite Electron renderer (useSyncExternalStore import error).
summary: Desktop renderer crashed: use-sync-external-store/shim is CJS; Vite served it as ESM so useSyncExternalStore named import failed. Aliased use-sync-external-store/shim to react (React 19 exports the hook). Dedupe react/react-dom/use-sync-external-store; prebundle with-selector paths.
